description: A beginner-friendly workout designed to improve endurance using machine and dumbbell exercises.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press + Row Combo
exercises.notes: Focus on smooth transitions between the press and row movements.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat to Press
exercises.notes: Maintain a steady pace to build endurance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.notes: Alternate legs and keep a consistent rhythm.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Control the movement to maximize muscle engagement.

description: A workout focused on building chest endurance using intermediate-level exercises.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.notes: Focus on controlled movements and squeezing the chest at the top of the motion.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press Machine
exercises.notes: Maintain a steady pace and ensure full range of motion.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.notes: Keep your core engaged and avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.notes: Focus on bringing the cables together in a smooth, controlled manner.

workout_name: Advanced Endurance Chest and Full Body Workout
description: A challenging workout designed to build endurance in the chest and full body using advanced exercises.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press
exercises.notes: Press each arm independently to ensure balanced strength development.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
exercises.notes: Focus on controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.notes: Perform a front squat followed by an overhead press for full body activation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Snatch
exercises.notes: Explosively lift the dumbbell overhead to build power and endurance.
